objective: Improve the ARC-specialized Qwen3-4B model's intrinsic Gold-path probability before TTT/search by continued LoRA SFT on program-verified Dots3-generated curricula.

teacher.prompt_inputs: abstract concept-family specifications only; no ARC-AGI-2 evaluation grids, no Micro12 grids, no Kaggle test content
teacher.output: JSON containing puzzle description plus pure-Python/numpy generate_input(seed) and transform(grid) functions

contamination_guards: Never include ARC-AGI-2 public evaluation grids or task IDs in teacher prompts or student training.
Never include Micro12 grids/task IDs in teacher prompts or student training.
Hold out complete synthetic concept families, not random rows.
A teacher draft cannot enter SFT until program execution, determinism, grid validity, diversity and deduplication all PASS.

phase_m1a.name: DOTS3_CURRICULUM_LORA_PILOT

primary_eval.compare: M1a versus frozen M0 on byte-identical evaluation episodes

scale_gate: greedy exact-grid accuracy does not regress
at least 2/3 held-out family buckets have non-negative Top1 delta

phase_m1b.decision_after_training: Only then retrain task-specific TTT adapters and compare same frozen search/retention budgets against M0.

stop_rules: If M1a fails the frozen scale gate, do not spend GPU on M1b.
Do not tune on Micro12 Gold.
Do not alter the holdout family split after seeing results.
